what_the_pattern_grammar_cannot_say.limit: a star never stands for white space, so no pattern matches a free-text argument of more than one word - not even '*'
and so no 'contains' pattern works on one either: the star would have to cross the spaces around the words it keeps
what_the_pattern_grammar_cannot_say.value: I've seen it in the meeting room!

what_the_pattern_grammar_cannot_say.limit: a pattern is a whole-value match with no negation, so the useful pin for a message body - 'no address in it' - cannot be written at all
what_the_pattern_grammar_cannot_say.shown_by: no grammar for it; the nearest, a literal, holds the body to one exact string
